C9000168.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 168 (Combinatorial invariance of Kazhdan–Lusztig polynomials.; papers: Combinatorial invariance of Kazhdan–Lusztig polynomials; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/168.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_QUANTIFIED_OBSTRUCTION.statement: Supply either a fully checked genuine counterexample or a uniform proof of the actual edge-image inclusions and simultaneous induction; finite passing tests and conditional vector rigidity are insufficient.
